high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from medium.com, displaying an article about the brain's functional structures, specifically focusing on Brodmann's Areas and their nested functional units. The text at the top of the image reads: "And Brodmann’s Areas are, in turn, composed of smaller nested functional structures. The following cartoon diagram illustrates an example of a functional unit called a hypercolumn that is located within Brodmann’s Area 17, which is in turn located in the occipital lobe and processes information related to vision.
